import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem reciprocal_power_partial_sums_converge (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ) (h : s = (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p)) : ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  subst h
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p
  have hf_eq : (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p) =
      fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i := rfl
  rw [hf_eq]
  have hSumm : Summable f := by
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded (g := fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ))
    · have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by
        have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
        linarith
      have h0 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) :=
        (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow).mpr hp1
      have h1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) := by
        have h_eq : (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) =
            fun n => (fun m : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) (n + 1) := rfl
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun m : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) 1).mpr h0
      exact h1
    · intro n
      unfold f
      have h1 : ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ = 1 := by
        rw [norm_pow, hz, one_pow]
      have h2 : ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p‖ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ) := by
        calc ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p‖ = ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)‖ ^ p := by rw [norm_pow]
          _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p := by rw [Complex.norm_natCast]
          _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ) := by rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
      have h_eq : ‖z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p‖ = (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ) := by
        calc ‖z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p‖
            = ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ / ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p‖ := by rw [norm_div]
          _ = 1 / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) := by rw [h1, h2]
          _ = (1 : ℝ) / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (p : ℝ)) := rfl
      exact le_of_eq h_eq
  exact ⟨∑' n, f n, hSumm.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat⟩

  have hreal : Summable (fun i : ℕ => 1 / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p) := by

      rw [norm_div, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast])
  have hs :
      Summable (fun i : ℕ => z ^ (i + 1) / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ p) :=
    hnorm.of_norm
  exact
